objective_text.T72.01.b: Implement co_next, co_flow_next and co_fold without an iterator library, then build an unfused equivalent and compare exact source-pull and callback counts before timing.

objective_text.T72.03.b: Implement allocator-backed Fibonacci generators with one owned frame, stable DONE, cancellation through destroy and exactly-once release, plus a caller-provided-frame alternative under an equal value contract.
objective_text.T72.03.c: Inject allocation failure, count0/1/47, suspension then destroy, repeated destroy through the cleared owner and interleaved generators. Compare every value with an independent integer recurrence and record allocation counts; reject extra-yield and omitted-release mutants.
objective_text.T72.03.d: Make yielded values own heap buffers and retain one across suspension. Define borrow/transfer/clone explicitly and compare cleanup after partial construction; delayed assessment introduces an address-sensitive self-reference that forbids moving the frame.

objective_text.T72.04.a: Derive the SysV stack-entry alignment and callee-preserved context, separating ABI obligations, ISO C, compiler extensions and detector annotations.
objective_text.T72.04.b: Implement the assembly context switch plus fresh/resume/yield/completed/destroyed lifecycle on a caller-owned aligned stack; preserve FP control and integrate ASan/TSan fiber APIs.
objective_text.T72.04.c: Run real two-yield callbacks with persistent locals, architectural RSP inside the supplied stack and independent caller/fiber rounding modes. objective_text.T72.05.b: Implement the factorial0..12 frame with a bounded multiplier stack, one-transition budgets, stable completion and cancellation, without recursive calls or tail-call optimization assumptions.

objective_text.T72.05.d: Replace factorial with a binary expression evaluator whose continuations own temporary buffers. Define tagged continuation cases, overflow/error propagation and cancellation cleanup; delayed assessment introduces an externally supplied continuation that can suspend rather than immediately return.
